FULL TEXT:
Ref.No.9635/2026/E1 Collector’s Office,
Coimbatore.
Dated: 24.11.2026
NOTIFICATION
Constitution of Panel of Senior Advocates for conducting the cases under the
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
(Central Act 33 of 1989)
In exercise of the powers conferred under sub-rule (1) of rule 4 of the Scheduled
Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Rules, 1995 read with the
provisions of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of
Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Central Act 33 of 1989) and in compliance with the directions
issued by the Hon’ble Madurai Bench of Madras High Court in W.P.(MD) No.8172 of
2008, dated 25.02.2020 and G.O.(Ms) No.31, Home (Courts-VIA) Department, dated
22.01.2026, applications are invited from eligible Advocates for inclusion in the panel
of Senior Advocates for conducting cases and allied proceedings under the SC/ST Act
in Coimbatore District.
Name of the post Name of the court and place No. of
Posts
Eminent Senior
Advocates
For conducting criminal cases more specifically the
cases under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled
Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Central
Act 33 of 1989) in Coimbatore District.
5
No person shall be eligible for empanelment as eminent Senior Advocate under
the said sub-rule (1) of rule (4), unless he has completed a continuous practice as an
Advocate for a period of not less than SEVEN YEARS, having sufficient experience in
conducting criminal cases more specifically the cases under the Scheduled Castes
and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Central Act 33 of 1989).
The Upper Age Limit shall be 60 years and their empanelment shall
automatically cease on attaining the age of 60 years unless the Government
specifically orders otherwise.
Hence Advocates practicing in the courts of Tamil Nadu for not less than
SEVEN YEARS and who are willing to accept the post are requested to express their
willingness in writing to the undersigned by furnishing the particulars in the prescribed
Application Form in Annexure I and II in six copies with two passport size
photographs to this office, and the application should reach this office on or before
11.12.2026.
The Applications received after 6.00 PM on 11.12.2026 will not be considered.
Encl: Annexure I & II Sd./- Pavankumar G. Giriyappanavar,
District Collector,
Coimbatore.
